Class Version

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.Version
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Version>
public class Version extends Object implements Comparable<Version>
Version string is of the form "<digits>.<digits>.<digits>-SNAPSHOT" where "-SNAPSHOT" is optional and missing components are 0; so 4.1 is treated as 4.1.0.

In addition, a version may end in -<anything> and is considered pre-release. The pre-release string is converted to lower case.
For comparisons regular-release > pre-release > snapshot.
For example 1.2.3 > 1.2.3-RC1 > 1.2.3-SNAPSHOT.
For example 1.2.3-RC2 > 1.2.3-RC1

Version is comparable, for example, 

if (Version.get().compareTo(Version.get("4.0.11")) >= 0) {
    // Do this for SwingSet version 4.0.11 and later
}
assert Version.get("4.0").compareTo(Version.get("4.0.0")) == 0;
assert Version.get("4.0.11-SNAPSHOT").compareTo(Version.get("4.0.11")) < 0;

    • get

      public static Version get()
      Returns the singleton Version of the running SwingSet library. If the version property is not found, or there is a parse error, then 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT is used.
      Returns:
      version

    • get

      public static Version get(String sVer)
      Returns the Version resulting from parsing the sVer param. If there is a parse error, then 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT is used. The return values are useful for comparing.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      version
